text: House File 2580 H-8226 Amend House File 2580 as follows: 1 1. Page 9, after line 24 by inserting: 2 < 16. a. Beginning no later than twelve months after 3 the commencement of commercial operation of a wind energy 4 conversion facility, and annually thereafter, the facility 5 owner or operator shall cause to be performed a comprehensive 6 inspection of all turbine blades and shall file a written 7 report of the inspection results with the county auditor of 8 each county in which the facility is located. 9 b. Each annual blade inspection shall be performed by 10 a qualified blade inspection technician who is independent 11 of the facility owner and operator and who holds a current 12 certification from a nationally recognized wind energy 13 technical training program. The inspection shall include all 14 of the following: 15 (1) A visual and photographic assessment of the condition of 16 the leading edge of each blade on each turbine in the facility, 17 documenting the extent and severity of any erosion, pitting, 18 cracking, delamination, or loss of leading edge protection 19 material. 20 (2) An estimate, for each blade inspected, of the mass 21 of material lost due to erosion since the prior inspection, 22 or since initial installation if the inspection is the first 23 annual inspection, expressed in grams. 24 (3) A classification of the erosion severity of each blade 25 using the following scale: 26 (a) “Category 1”, meaning surface coating erosion only with 27 no exposure of fiberglass substrate. 28 (b) “Category 2”, meaning partial erosion of coating with 29 limited exposure of fiberglass substrate. 30 (c) “Category 3”, meaning significant erosion with 31 substantial exposure of fiberglass substrate. 32 (d) “Category 4”, meaning structural erosion with loss of 33 fiberglass material or delamination of blade layers. 34 (4) For any blade classified as category 3 or category 35 -1- HF 2580.3228 (2) 91 sb/js 1/ 2 #1. 4, a detailed assessment of the fiberglass and microplastic 1 emissions from that blade and a recommended timeline for repair 2 or replacement. 3 c. The annual inspection report shall be filed with the 4 county auditor within sixty days of the completion of the 5 inspection. A copy of the report shall be made available to 6 any owner of nonparticipating property within one mile of the 7 facility upon written request. 8 d. If any blade is classified as category 4 the facility 9 owner or operator shall take the affected turbine out of 10 service within thirty days and shall not return the turbine to 11 service until the blade has been repaired or replaced and a 12 follow-up inspection confirms that the blade condition has been 13 restored to category 1 or category 2. 14 e. The facility owner or operator shall bear all costs of 15 the annual blade inspections and reports required under this 16 subsection. 17 f. All inspection reports filed under this subsection shall 18 be public records. 19 g. This subsection shall not apply to a renewable electric 20 power generation facility that does not include a wind energy 21 conversion facility. > 22 2.
